Briggy Bum Farm Equine Rescue is a registered non profit Equine ( horse) rescue located on Prince Edward Island, Canada. 
Started and incorporated in January 2019 we moved forward as a collective group to become a non profit to be able to advocate, fundraise and help horses from all over Canada. 

Our Rescue come from all kinds of different situations and we are currently fundraising to help keep horses from Slaughter. 

Over 70,000 horses a year leave Canada and are bound for overseas and international destinations to be inhumanely treated after years of lending their service to us.. 

Watch how we take these beautiful, majestic creatures and how we train and rehome them to a loving forever home.
